values.note: RV sites with electricity $30; tent sites $15 per tent (an extra tent on an RV site is $15). Bismarck Parks and Recreation page, read 2026-11-12.

fees.source: https://www.bisparks.org/facilities/general-sibley-park-campground/ ('Camping Fees: RV campsites with electricity: $30 per night; Tent campsites: $15 per tent per night'); general-sibley-campground-information ('one tent is allowed at an RV campsite in addition to one RV; the standard tent camping fee applies'), read 2026-11-12

hookups.source: https://www.bisparks.org/rentals-reservations/campgrounds/general-sibley-campground-campsites/ ('All RV campsites have 20-30-50 amp electricity. No campsites have water or sewer hookups.'), read 2026-11-12

values.note: 113 RV sites (1-109, with doubles 74, 75, 108 and 109 split A/B) plus a separate tent area. Sites 38 and 80-92 are for units under 25 ft; pull-throughs 45, 83, 85, 86, 89 and 90; asphalt pads on 16-57 except 28 and 45, gravel elsewhere.

sites.source: https://www.bisparks.org/rentals-reservations/campgrounds/general-sibley-campground-campsites/ ('Pull-thru Sites: 45, 83, 85, 86, 89, 90'; 'Double Sites: 74A-B, 75A-B, 108A-B, 109A-B'; 'Small Sites for Units Less than 25 Feet: 38 and 80-92'; 'Asphalt Pads: 16-57 except 28 and 45 (gravel pads all other sites)'); 2026 RV area map (sites 1-109), read 2026-11-12

facilities.source: https://www.bisparks.org/facilities/general-sibley-park-campground/ ('Features: RV campsites with electrical hook-ups; Tent campsites; Showers; Water and dump station'); campsites page ('Potable water and dump station are available near campground entrance'), read 2026-11-12

values.note: Booked online through the Bismarck Parks reservation site; 2027 reservations open March 24 at 8:00am. Campers without a reservation register at the park office. 14 nights in any 30 days, reserved or first-come. Cancellations at least 48 hours ahead, $5 per night per site.

booking.source: https://www.bisparks.org/facilities/general-sibley-park-campground/ ('Reservations: open March 24, 2027, at 8:00am'; 'Reserve Campsite by Map' -> anc.apm.activecommunities.com/bismarckparks); general-sibley-campground-information ('Campers without reservations must report to the General Sibley Park Office during office hours to register'; 'Stays for any camping group (reservation or first-come) are limited to 14 nights within any consecutive 30-day period'; 'A cancellation fee of $5 per night per campsite'), read 2026-11-12

note: City campground in the 155-acre General Sibley Park along the Missouri River just south of Bismarck, run by the Bismarck Parks and Recreation District. RV loops under cottonwoods; small-boat ramp (under 15 ft), 18-hole disc golf, nature trails and an amphitheater. --Claude
summary: Bismarck Parks pages confirm $30 RV (20/30/50-amp, no water or sewer at sites), tent $15; showers, water, dump; 113 RV sites with 6 pull-throughs and 14 under-25-ft sites; online booking (ActiveNet) from March 24, 14 in 30; season May 7-Oct 11, 2027. Water/sewer false and season added; groups manual; note trimmed. Not waterfront stands.
